ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high contrast; the visible ventral surface is approximately 90% low-intensity (black) pixels with 10% high-intensity (white/grey) pixels concentrated in linear scars and mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark field across both lobes; left lobe features multiple high-intensity diagonal linear paths (coordinates: center-left to lower-left); right lobe features diffuse, low-density light-grey mottling in the upper-mid quadrant; distal tips are dominated by high-intensity textured clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Clearly visible central notch forming a shallow V-shape; approximate pixel angle of 120 degrees with a vertical depth of approximately 1/8th the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing edge showing low-amplitude serrations across the span; significant textural protrusion and pixel-level jaggedness at both the left and right distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a gentle convexity from the notch outwards, transitioning into straight segments towards the lateral terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity, granular pixel clusters located at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; several small, isolated high-intensity circular focal points scattered across the central fluke area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 4-6 distinct, parallel high-contrast linear streaks on the left lobe surface; several shorter, less defined linear marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel linear scarring (rake marks) on the left lobe; heavy irregular textured masses at both lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced high-contrast, irregular structural accumulation at the distal-most points of the fluke span.
